title: Weight-Overage Standing Allowance by Days Since Completion — Case Digest
content:
# Weight-overage refunds: standing allowance by days since completion

Case digest for Cartwise Grocery Orders.

## Rule

The weight-overage standing allowance is added to the weight-overage refund after the refund is rounded to the cent:

- when at least 2 calendar days have passed from the date of the order's completion to today and no weight-overage refund stands on the order yet, the allowance is 1.00;
- when exactly 1 calendar day has passed and no weight-overage refund stands on the order yet, it is 0.50;
- otherwise there is none.

The refund with the allowance added never exceeds the line's billed charge.

Calendar days are counted from the date part of the order's completion time: the completion date is day 0, the next calendar date is day 1, and so on, whatever the hour of completion.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Days since completion | Weight-overage refund already standing on the order | Allowance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | 3 | none | 1.00 |
| B | 2 | none | 1.00 |
| C | 1 | none | 0.50 |
| D | 0 (completed today) | none | none |
| E | 4 | one already stands | none |
| F | 1 | one already stands | none |

**Case G (hypothetical figures).** A rounded weight-overage refund of 1.60 on a line billed at 10.40, with 2 days since completion and no weight-overage refund yet on the order: 1.60 plus 1.00 gives 2.60, within the line charge, so the refund is 2.60.

**Case H (hypothetical figures).** The same 1.60 and allowance of 1.00 on a line billed at only 2.20: 2.60 would exceed the line charge, so the refund is held at 2.20.
